lines.zh: 我一步一晃，身上叮当作响。
lines.en: I waddle, and something on me chimes.

lines.zh: 我的壳边泛着一层微光。
lines.en: A faint glow rims my shell.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地在地上擦着走。
lines.en: I shuffle along the ground.
My short legs work hard.
I squeeze out of a stone gap.
I shake, and flecks of light fall.
I go around the puddle so I stay dry.
Round as I am, I waddle.
My shadow on the ground is round.
I follow slowly behind you.
The slope is a bit hard for me.
I stop and wobble.

lines.zh: 我从草里挪出来，亮闪闪的。
lines.en: I shuffle out of the grass, all glinting.

lines.zh: 我蹲着，壳上的光一闪一闪。
lines.en: I crouch, and my shell flickers.
I gnaw a stone for my teeth.
It's quiet here. I'll stay.
My glow shows more in the dark.
I blink slowly.
I tuck my legs under my shell.

lines.zh: 有只虫子爬过我，我没管。
lines.en: A bug crawls over me; I don't mind.
I listen to water far off.
I tilt my head and look.

lines.zh: 我的光把周围照亮了一点。
lines.en: My glow lights the ground a little.
I wait for someone to pet me.
I turn a circle on my own.
I'm a little warm.

lines.zh: 我把身体往石头边靠了靠。
lines.en: I lean toward the stone.
My shell is hard; I'm soft inside.
Your light is brighter than mine.
The shine on me isn't fire.

lines.zh: 仰头太久，我的眼睛发酸。
lines.en: Looking up so long makes my eyes ache.
What are you holding in your palm?
I'm not afraid, only cautious.
My glow changes with my mood.
My shell will feel cool to your hand.
That bit of shine on my shell flickers.
Would you take me home?

lines.zh: 我身上这块石头，很好看吧。
lines.en: The stone on me is pretty, isn't it?
You smile, and my glow brightens.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地蹭了蹭你的裤脚。
lines.en: I rub slowly against your trouser leg.
When you leave, I follow.
I look up and wait for your hand.

lines.zh: 你要是坐着，我就趴在旁边。
lines.en: If you sit, I'll lie beside you.

lines.zh: 我们认识多久了？我记不清。
lines.en: How long have we known each other? I forget.

lines.zh: 我的壳上有你手的印子。
lines.en: Your handprint is on my shell.

lines.zh: 你叫我的名字，我就过来。
lines.en: Call my name and I come.

lines.zh: 我这一身光，是给你看的。
lines.en: This glow of mine is for you.

lines.zh: 腿太短，追不上你的步子。
lines.en: These short legs can't match your stride.
My shell is scratched.
A patch of light on my shell goes dark.

lines.zh: 我这一身亮，藏也藏不住。
lines.en: With this shine, I can't hide.
I make a thin little cry.
That put me flat on the ground.
My legs give, and I flop back down.

lines.zh: 我缩进壳里，只露一点光。
lines.en: I shrink into my shell, only my glow showing.

lines.zh: 我抖了一下，石块掉下来。
lines.en: I shudder and a stone chip falls.
You hit harder than I assumed.
I inch away.
I smell that food.
You've opened your palm.
I inch over a little at a time.
My glow has brightened a little.

lines.zh: 这点东西，够我高兴半天。
lines.en: This much keeps me happy half the day.
I stretch my head and sniff your hand.
You've set it on the ground.
I won't snatch; I'll wait for you to move.
That smell makes my shell warm.
I eat it slowly, bite by bite.

lines.zh: 你要是摸我，我就吃得更快。
lines.en: Pet me and I'll eat faster.
I rest my head on your hand.
I'll remember this sweetness.
I trace a little circle around you.
Don't take it away.
When I'm done I'll lie at your feet.

lines.zh: 这是我今天最好的一顿。
lines.en: This is my best meal today.
One bump from you, and I roll into the grass.

lines.zh: 我的壳碰着你的鞋，很响。
lines.en: My shell clacks against your boot.
I shuffle half a step aside, shell scraping.
Don't push; my short legs aren't steady.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，我的光闪了一下。
lines.en: We collide and my glow flickers.

lines.zh: 我壳上的亮点，会自己移动。
lines.en: The bright spots on my shell move on their own.
I lean on you; it's warm.
That made me wobble twice.
I go around to your other side.
You slide me a short way.
Another one is glowing too.
Our glows slowly align.
Its shell is greener than mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起趴在一块石头上。
lines.en: We lie on the same stone.
It rests its head against my shell.

lines.zh: 两只的光合在一起，很亮。
lines.en: Our two glows join and brighten.
We nudge each other slowly.

lines.zh: 这里的石头够我们两个。
lines.en: There's room on this stone for both.

lines.zh: 以后会有小的跟着我们。
lines.en: Soon little ones will follow us.
At night we lie very close.
I take a small piece in my mouth.
I'll keep this stone.
I press it under my shell.
It's bright; I look twice.
I can't drag it, so I leave it.
I like this one.

lines.zh: 我一点一点推到你的鞋前。
lines.en: I nudge it to your boot, bit by bit.
I'll sniff before I decide.
Something glows; I go get it.
This bright pebble goes into a shell seam.

lines.zh: 你踩到我，我的光闪了一下。
lines.en: You step on me, and my light flares.
My glow has dimmed.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，光也跟着转。
lines.en: I turn slowly, and my glow turns with me.
You took my thing.
I raise a foreleg with effort.
Don't squeeze; my shell dents at a touch.
I can ram too, you know.
No more hiding; I turn my shell to you.
I shift to face you.
Come closer, and my light will blind you.
I follow you slowly.
My glow stays on.
Wherever you go, I shuffle after.
I wait for your feet to stop moving.
I'm getting hot.
Don't go toward the stones.

lines.zh: 你走三步，我的光就亮一分。
lines.en: Every three steps, my glow brightens a notch.

lines.zh: 我的壳边泛着微光，一步步擦着走。
lines.en: My shell edge glows faintly as I scrape along.
One step closer and I'll ram.

lines.zh: 我把软软的身子绷紧了。
lines.en: I tense my soft little body.

lines.zh: 壳一顶，撞在你小腿骨上。
lines.en: My shell butts into your shin.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，可我尽力了。
lines.en: It's light, but I tried.
I clamp onto the toe of your boot.

lines.zh: 你退开，我还站着，源石壳没碎。
lines.en: Step back; I am standing, my Originium shell intact.
I slip and hit a stone.

lines.zh: 我的壳碰到了你的膝盖。
lines.en: My shell knocks your knee.
I turn and ram again.
You brush me aside.
I'm panting, and my glow dims.
I lie down and stop.
A little light shows from a stone crack.
I crawl out from under a stone.

lines.zh: 地上多了一团亮亮的东西。
lines.en: A bright little lump appears on the ground.

lines.zh: 我从土里滚出来，壳还亮。
lines.en: I roll out of the dirt, shell still glowing.
It's quiet here. Good for living.

lines.zh: 我的光先亮，然后我才动。
lines.en: My glow comes on before I move.
I raise my shiny little head.

lines.zh: 我被谁放在这块石头上。
lines.en: Someone set me on this stone.
I turn one circle in place.
I lie down and hide myself.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的壳，我不敢动。
lines.en: Fire heats my shell and I dare not move.

lines.zh: 我从石头上滚下来，摔得发懵。
lines.en: I roll off the stone, dazed.
Water gets in my shell and I struggle.

lines.zh: 爆风把我这小东西吹起来。
lines.en: The blast blows my little body up.

lines.zh: 一枚东西打在我的壳上。
lines.en: Something strikes my shell.
That spell puts out all my glow.

lines.zh: 太久没吃东西，光都弱了。
lines.en: Too long unfed; my glow is weak.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的壳全亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my whole shell lights up.

lines.zh: 虚空把我往下拖，我挣着。
lines.en: The void pulls me down and I struggle.
